stimulus: text. Unit−3; Lesson−2(B)  10 May 1st is an (a) ⎯⎯ Workers Day which is (b) ⎯⎯ in most countries. It reminds the historic (c) ⎯⎯ of working people across the (d) ⎯⎯. All the privileges workers (e) ⎯⎯ today, came about due to the (f) ⎯⎯ of the workers in (g) ⎯⎯. It was May 3, 1886 when police (h) ⎯⎯ into a crowd of strikers. As a result, at least one was (i) ⎯⎯ on the spot and five or six (j) ⎯⎯ were injured seriously.
guide_solution: Filling in the gaps without clues (a) international (b) recognized (c) struggles/sacrifices (d) world (e) enjoy (f) efforts/sacrifices (g) 1880s/history/1886 (h) fired/attacked (i) killed (j) strikers/others
